tool.help:
**What it does**
`PMultiQC <https://github.com/bigbio/pmultiqc>`_ is a MultiQC plugin for comprehensive quality control reporting of mass spectrometry-based proteomics data. It aggregates results from proteomics search/quantification pipelines into a single interactive HTML report with QC metrics and visualizations.
**Inputs**
You need to tell the tool which software generated the results, using the **Which tool was used to generate the results?** dropdown. Currently supported data sources:
* **quantms**: `experimental_design.tsv`, `*.mzTab` identification results, and optionally `*.mzML` spectra files and `*.idXML` identification files * **MaxQuant**: `parameters.txt`, `proteinGroups.txt`, `summary.txt`, `evidence.txt`, `msms.txt`, `msmsScans.txt` * **mzIdentML**: `*.mzid` files and optionally the corresponding `*.mzML` or `*.mgf` spectra files * **FragPipe**: `psm.tsv` and `ion.tsv` (or `combined_ion.tsv`, `combined_peptide.tsv`, `combined_protein.tsv`) * **nf-core/mhcquant**: the pmultiqc output files of the mhcquant results folder (`multiqc_general_stats.txt`, `multiqc_chromatogram.txt`, ..., `percolator_plot.txt`) * **QPX**: `*.psm.parquet`, `*.pg.parquet`, `*.feature.parquet`, `*.run.parquet`, `*.sample.parquet`
Each report covers the results of **one** software tool; select all files of that tool in the corresponding input fields (multiple files are supported). pmultiqc processes only one software module per report (only one `--*-plugin` flag may be active per run, see the pmultiqc CLI reference), so results from different tools require separate reports.
**Report content**
The report contains an experimental design overview, a pipeline performance overview (contaminants score, peptide intensity, charge score, missed cleavages, ID rate over RT, MS2 oversampling, peptide missing values), summary tables with spectra/peptide/protein counts, identification statistics (spectra tracking, search engine scores, precursor charges, number of peaks per MS/MS spectrum, peak intensity distributions, delta mass), and peptide/protein quantification tables.
**Options**
The *pmultiqc report options* section exposes the pmultiqc command line options:
* `--remove-decoy/--no-remove-decoy`, `--decoy-affix`, `--contaminant-affix`, `--affix-type`: handling of decoy and contaminant entries during counting * `--condition`: create conditions from provided (e.g. factor) columns of the experimental design * `--keep-raw`: keep filenames in the experimental design output as raw * `--quantification-method`: quantification method for LFQ experiments (`feature_intensity` or `spectral_counting`) * `--disable-table`: disable the protein/peptide table plots for large datasets * `--disable-hoverinfo`: disable interactive hover tooltips in the plots
-----
pmultiqc is developed by the `bigbio <https://github.com/bigbio>`_ community. For more information see the `documentation <https://pmultiqc.quantms.org/>`_.
